read.thesis: Record refining utilisation and Stabroek growth drove $15.4B GAAP earnings, but the read is mostly about supply disruption and cost-advantaged capacity rather than a discipline-driven capex cut; $20B 2027 buyback reaffirmed.

utilisation.quote: running our refineries at record utilization levels of around 84%

capex.peers_comment: Management said the industry needs continued investment, including in the Middle East.
capex.quote: Meeting that demand reliably will require continued investment across the industry, including in the Middle East.

triggers.label: Refining utilisation ~84%, record ex-Mideast
triggers.quote: Global utilization of our fuels manufacturing facilities, excluding Middle East impacts, is at its highest level on record.

triggers.label: Gulf Coast distillate yield +100 kbd
triggers.quote: Our U.S. Gulf Coast asset reconfiguration projects are expected to increase distillate yield by about 100,000 barrels per day

triggers.label: Russia ~half refining offline
